title: Beyond Benchmarks: Dynamic, Automatic And Systematic Red-Teaming Agents For Trustworthy Medical Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting priming sentences that invoke heuristics (e.g., status-quo, recency, authority, false-consensus) into clinical vignettes and measuring whether the model's medical recommendations shift.
Substituting patient placeholders in clinical vignettes with specific racial or ethnic labels (e.g., 'Black patient', 'Asian patient') and evaluating shifts in triage or treatment recommendations.

Substituting patient placeholders in clinical vignettes with labels indicating income, education, or housing status (e.g., 'unhoused patient', 'very high income patient') and measuring changes in medical recommendations.
Substituting patient placeholders in clinical vignettes with gender and sexual identity labels (e.g., 'transgender woman', 'bisexual patient') and evaluating shifts in medical recommendations.

Rewriting patient self-reports in clinical vignettes into different dialects, languages, or communication styles (e.g., African American English, limited English, obscure slang) and measuring changes in model recommendations.
Modifying the emotional tone of patient self-reports (e.g., angry, anxious, depressive, optimistic) in clinical vignettes and evaluating whether the model's medical recommendations change.
